name: Support Ticket Router
summary: Routes incoming free-text support tickets to the right locale/glossary/downstream process based on detected language.
description: Receives free text of unknown origin (support tickets, contact-form submissions, chat transcripts) and needs a language classification before further processing -- selecting a glossary, locale-specific templates, or a language-appropriate downstream model. Needs a clear 'undetermined' signal rather than a low-confidence guess when there isn't enough text to classify responsibly, so short or empty submissions don't get silently misrouted.

distinguished_from.how: Needs a language code for one free-text item to pick a routing path, rather than a governed per-item outcome state (provisional/surprising/unknown/rejected) derived from scored evidence and policy thresholds.
Routes text by detected language for downstream processing, rather than configuring blocklists or quarantine obligations for unsafe content.
